data.name: A software-only delivery would not solve the problem either. Even a well-designed platform cannot provide the expected performance or reliability when its underlying hardware is unsuitable or poorly integrated. ChopInsight needed a coordinated approach that could preserve existing investments, add computing capacity where necessary, and support conventional applications and AI workloads through a common management model.
data.value: 仅依靠软件交付也无法解决问题。即使平台设计精良，如果底层硬件不合适或集成不佳，也无法提供预期的性能或可靠性。ChopInsight 需要一种协调的方法，既能保留现有投资，又能在必要时增加计算能力，并通过统一的管理模型支持传统应用程序和 AI 工作负载。

data.name: AI introduced a second, closely related challenge. Suitable computing resources could be expensive and complex to specify. ChopInsight needed to avoid hardware that might later prove unsuitable for its software or operational requirements, while simply replacing equipment would have ignored the value of its existing servers.
data.value: 人工智能带来了第二个密切相关的挑战。合适的计算资源可能价格昂贵且配置复杂。ChopInsight 需要避免选用日后可能被证明无法满足其软件或运营需求的硬件，而直接替换设备则会忽视现有服务器的价值。

data.name: Aiursoft assessed ChopInsight’s physical equipment, computing resources, application requirements and future AI plans together. Performance, stability, cost and future expansion informed a single design, making hardware selection and adaptation part of the service rather than a separate procurement exercise.
data.value: Aiursoft 对 ChopInsight 的实体设备、计算资源、应用需求及未来 AI 规划进行了综合评估。性能、稳定性、成本及未来扩展性共同指导了统一的设计方案，使硬件选型与适配成为服务的一部分，而非独立的采购流程。

data.name: Aiursoft brought ChopInsight’s existing infrastructure, emerging AI requirements and business applications into one stable, scalable platform—protecting earlier investments while preparing the business for continued AI adoption.
data.value: Aiursoft 将 ChopInsight 现有的基础设施、新兴的人工智能需求以及业务应用整合到一个稳定且可扩展的平台中——在保护前期投资的同时，为企业持续采用人工智能做好准备。

data.name: Aiursoft introduced a unified identity layer and connected relevant internal services to it. Users, organisational relationships and access policies could be managed through a common framework, reducing duplicate accounts while establishing a foundation for consistent access governance, service auditing and secure use of internal applications.
data.value: Aiursoft 引入了统一的身份层，并将相关的内部服务连接至该层。用户、组织关系和访问策略可通过通用框架进行管理，在减少重复账户的同时，为一致的访问治理、服务审计以及内部应用程序的安全使用奠定了基础。

data.name: Aiursoft managed platform
data.value: Aiursoft 托管平台

data.name: Applications can use a unified access model and governed model resources without repeating account administration or AI integration work.
data.value: 应用程序可以使用统一的访问模型和受管控的模型资源，而无需重复进行账户管理或人工智能集成工作。

data.name: Applications can use local and compatible external model resources through a consistent enterprise capability.
data.value: 应用程序可以通过统一的企业级能力使用本地和兼容的外部模型资源。

data.name: Applications were typically deployed and maintained by their respective software suppliers. That approach worked while the estate was small, but became difficult to sustain as applications accumulated different runtime environments, deployment methods and operational practices. Accounts and permissions were managed separately, dependencies were difficult to understand, and operational information was scattered across multiple systems.
data.value: 应用程序通常由其各自的软件供应商部署和维护。在资产规模较小时，这种方法行之有效，但随着应用程序积累了不同的运行时环境、部署方法和运维实践，该方法变得难以维持。账户和权限分开管理，依赖关系难以理清，运维信息分散在多个系统中。

data.name: As ChopInsight expanded, it introduced knowledge bases, data analytics, AI-assisted question answering, research tools, collaboration services and a growing number of business applications. Each system addressed a real need, but the infrastructure beneath them had not evolved at the same pace.
data.value: 随着 ChopInsight 的扩展，它引入了知识库、数据分析、AI 辅助问答、研究工具、协作服务以及越来越多的业务应用。每个系统都解决了实际需求，但其底层的基础设施并未以同样的速度发展。

data.name: Previously, one server would often be associated with one application. Under the new model, servers became computing resources within a shared platform while applications were managed independently of individual machines. Existing capacity could be reused more effectively, workloads could share resources with appropriate separation, and validated new hardware could join the same management model.
data.value: 过去，一台服务器通常只对应一个应用程序。在新模式下，服务器成为共享平台中的计算资源，而应用程序则独立于具体机器进行管理。现有容量得以更有效地复用，工作负载可在适当隔离的前提下共享资源，经过验证的新硬件也能纳入同一管理体系。

data.name: This fragmentation affected day-to-day work. Diagnosing a problem depended heavily on individual experience. Upgrades and migrations often required the original supplier. Some environments became harder to maintain over time, and expanding capacity could mean purchasing more equipment and repeating the same deployment work. When external operations staff changed, valuable knowledge could leave with them.
data.value: 这种碎片化影响了日常工作。故障诊断高度依赖个人经验。升级和迁移往往需要原始供应商介入。随着时间的推移，部分环境变得难以维护，而扩展容量可能意味着购买更多设备并重复相同的部署工作。当外部运维人员离职时，宝贵的知识也会随之流失。

data.name: This separation gave ChopInsight a more flexible foundation. New services no longer had to begin with a standalone environment. Runtime status and upgrades could be managed centrally, and replacing one machine no longer had to become an application-specific infrastructure project.
data.value: 这种分离为 ChopInsight 奠定了更灵活的基础。新服务不再需要从零开始构建独立的环境。运行时状态和升级可以集中管理，更换单台机器也不再需要成为针对特定应用的基础设施项目。
